topic: Measuring Mass and Temperature with Balances and Thermometers
key_concepts: Milligrams, grams, and kilograms are units used to measure mass
Degrees Celsius is a unit used to measure temperature
Mass is the amount of matter an object has
Temperature tells how hot or cold an object is
One kilogram equals 1000 grams and one milligram is 1/1000 of a gram
Balances are instruments used to measure mass
Mechanical balances use springs, levers, and reference weights without electricity
A triple-beam balance is an example of a mechanical balance
Electronic analytical balances and digital laboratory thermometers are electronic measurin
Liquid-in-glass thermometers and digital thermometers measure temperature
Appropriate science equipment is chosen based on the nature of the test
Gases like air and liquids like water have mass and are matter
